name: lesoirdalgerie.com
body: Every internal link that was opened answered, and model-training crawlers are blocked by choice. But buttons must have discernible text.
lesson: Give every button text or an aria-label, so a screen reader can announce it.
summary: www.lesoirdalgerie.com scores 48 out of 100 (F). 12 checks fail now, 29 are at risk, and 25 pass. Fix first: HSTS is not sent.

fix.title: HSTS is not sent
fix.evidence: strict-transport-security was absent on the start page. Missing on all 20 pages analyzed. A first visit over http can be intercepted.

fix.title: Buttons must have discernible text
fix.evidence: axe-core 4.14.0 found 11 elements on /, /actualites, /periscoop, for example .owl-drag.inner.owl-carousel > .owl-dots > .owl-dot[role="button"]:nth-child(1) and .owl-drag.inner.owl-carousel > .owl-dots > .owl-dot[role="button"]:nth-child(2). Impact: critical.
fix.fix: Give each icon button visible text or an aria-label.

fix.title: Elements must meet minimum color contrast ratio thresholds
fix.evidence: axe-core 4.14.0 found 266 elements on /, /actualites, /periscoop, for example #up > ul:nth-child(1) > li:nth-child(1) > a[href$="www.lesoirdalgerie.com"] and #up > ul:nth-child(1) > li:nth-child(2) > a. Impact: serious.
fix.fix: Darken the text or lighten the background until normal text reaches 4.5:1 and large text 3:1.

fix.title: 1 AI answer or search crawler is blocked
fix.evidence: Amazonbot (Alexa answers) by Disallow: /. These bots fetch pages to cite them in answers. Blocked means the site is not quoted there.
fix.fix: Allow the answer bots in robots.txt. Training bots can stay blocked if that is the policy.

fix.title: ARIA hidden element must not be focusable or contain focusable elements
fix.evidence: axe-core 4.14.0 found 95 elements on /, /actualites, /periscoop, for example .mobile-hide > .is-slider > .owl-drag.inner.owl-carousel > .owl-height.owl-stage-outer > .owl-stage > .cloned.owl-item[f and .mobile-hide > .is-slider > .owl-drag.inner.owl-carousel…
fix.fix: Remove focusable elements from aria-hidden containers, or drop aria-hidden.

fix.title: Links must have discernible text
fix.evidence: axe-core 4.14.0 found 73 elements on /, /actualites, /periscoop, for example a[href$="#aside"] and #nav > ul:nth-child(2) > li:nth-child(2) > a. Impact: serious.
fix.fix: Give each link text, or an aria-label when it only holds an icon.

works.title: Every internal link that was opened answered
Model-training crawlers are blocked by choice
Plain http redirects permanently to https
The start page declares its language
The layout holds still while loading
Structured data parses and carries the expected properties
